actions.name: get_indicator_data
actions.description: Retrieve WHO GHO observations for an indicator with structured dimension and year filters.

indicatorCode.description: The indicator code, such as WHOSIS_000001.

anyOf.description: The exact dimension code, or null for a null check.

value.description: The exact dimension code, or null for a null check.

items.description: One exact or null dimension filter.

filters.description: Dimension field filters joined with the OData and operator.

startYear.description: The first observation year to include.

endYear.description: The last observation year to include.

top.description: The maximum number of records to return. Defaults to 100.

skip.description: The number of records to skip before collecting results.

inputSchema.description: An indicator code, optional filters, and pagination options.

items.description: The raw record returned by the WHO GHO OData API.
The indicator observation records in this page.

count.description: The number of records returned in this page.

outputSchema.description: A page of WHO GHO indicator observations.

actions.name: list_dimension_values
actions.description: List the available values for one WHO GHO dimension.

dimensionCode.description: The dimension code, such as COUNTRY or AGEGROUP.

top.description: The maximum number of records to return. Defaults to 100.

skip.description: The number of records to skip before collecting results.

inputSchema.description: A WHO GHO dimension code and pagination options.

items.description: The raw record returned by the WHO GHO OData API.
The dimension value records in this page.

count.description: The number of records returned in this page.

outputSchema.description: A page of values for one WHO GHO dimension.

actions.name: list_dimensions
actions.description: List dimensions available in the WHO Global Health Observatory OData API.

top.description: The maximum number of records to return. Defaults to 100.

skip.description: The number of records to skip before collecting results.

inputSchema.description: Pagination options for listing GHO dimensions.

items.description: The raw record returned by the WHO GHO OData API.
The dimension records in this page.

count.description: The number of records returned in this page.

outputSchema.description: A page of WHO GHO dimensions.

actions.name: search_indicators
actions.description: Search WHO GHO indicators by partial or exact indicator name.

query.description: Text contained in the indicator name.

exactMatch.description: Whether the query must equal the complete indicator name.

top.description: The maximum number of records to return. Defaults to 100.

skip.description: The number of records to skip before collecting results.

inputSchema.description: Search and pagination options for WHO GHO indicators.

items.description: The raw record returned by the WHO GHO OData API.
The indicator records in this page.

count.description: The number of records returned in this page.

outputSchema.description: A page of WHO GHO indicators.
